overview.title: Query public Claude Academy learning resources
overview.lede: Read-only JSON endpoints for searching and inspecting indexed public Claude Academy courses, collections, tutorials, and use cases without an API key.
overview.baseUrlLede: All endpoints are public read-only GET routes under this origin and require no API key or bearer token.
overview.quickStartHeading: Fetch your first page of resources
overview.quickStartLede: Run this curl command in your terminal to retrieve up to five indexed learning resources.
overview.endpointsLede: Select a catalog route to view its parameters and response schema, or open the operational routes directly.
overview.tryLede: Choose an endpoint to query the current local snapshot directly from your browser.

conventions.readOnly: Snapshot-backed reads: Every request reads a validated local snapshot and never triggers a crawl or source fetch.
conventions.cursors: Snapshot-scoped pagination: Results are ordered by ascending stable ca_ ID; cursors bind to your active filters and snapshotId, returning 400 on filter mismatch or 409 if the snapshot changed.
conventions.nulls: Explicit empty values: Responses use camelCase and keep all documented fields present, returning null or [] when a fact is unverified or absent on the source page.
conventions.durations: Durations: duration.courseMinutes holds the estimated time shown on the official page for courses, tutorials, and use cases. pathMinutes and videoSeconds are null for this source.
conventions.sources: Canonical source links: Each resource ID (ca_ plus 24 hex characters) hashes its canonical public Academy URL, and url plus provenance.sourceUrls link directly to the original pages.
conventions.notExposed: Catalog metadata only: The API does not provide enrollment, learner progress, course text, videos, or images. media is always [], and artwork links to the page's own share image on academy.claude.com.

overview.linksLede: Inspect the OpenAPI 3.1 schema, check server health, or view the repository.

resources.title: List and filter learning resources
resources.lede: Search the current snapshot by keyword, collection, or kind with deterministic cursor pagination.

params.q: Case-insensitive text search across resource titles, summaries, and tags such as product and role labels (up to 200 characters).
params.category: Collection slug from GET /v1/categories (lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens, up to 100 characters).
params.kind: Resource format filter: course, collection, tutorial, or use-case.
params.audience: Audience filter shared with the OpenAI Academy API: general, knowledge-workers, developers, leaders, educators, students, admins, or other. Claude Academy pages publish no audience, so audiences is [] on every resource.
params.cursor: Opaque pagination token from nextCursor; must be sent with the same filters against the same snapshotId.
params.limit: Maximum number of resources to return per page (1 to {max}, default {default}).

resources.shapeNote: Items are sorted by ascending resource ID so pages stay deterministic within a snapshot.

response.items: Page of matching Resource objects ordered by ascending stable ID.
response.nextCursor: Opaque cursor for the next page of results, or null when no further items match.
response.total: Total number of resources in the snapshot matching the active filters.
response.snapshotId: SHA-256 identifier of the snapshot serving this page.

resources.tryLede: Set optional filters and run a request. Changing any filter resets pagination to the first page.

filters.categoryUnavailable: The collection list could not be loaded from /v1/categories. You can still run other filters.

resources.empty: No resources in the current snapshot matched these filters. Clear or broaden a filter and run the request again.

resource.title: Fetch a single resource by ID
resource.lede: Fetch full metadata, the course outline or collection sections, duration, and provenance for a single resource ID.
resource.shapeNote: Every documented field is present in the JSON payload; unknown or unverified values are null or empty arrays.

fields.id: Stable identifier: ca_ followed by the first 24 lowercase hex characters of the canonical URL's SHA-256 hash.
fields.title: Official resource title from the public source page.
fields.url: Canonical public destination URL on academy.claude.com.
fields.kind: Resource format: course, collection, tutorial, or use-case.
fields.categoryIds: Slugs of the Academy collections that list this resource.
fields.audiences: Normalized audience values. Claude Academy pages publish no audience, so this list is empty.
fields.tags: Product and role labels shown on the source page, such as Claude Code or Sales.
fields.summary: Short description of the resource, or null when not stated on the source.
fields.level: Difficulty level (beginner, intermediate, or advanced), or null when the source page states none.
fields.duration: Object with courseMinutes (estimated time shown on the page), pathMinutes, and videoSeconds; values are never combined.
fields.detail: Structured notes: free-text audience, prerequisites and objectives (empty for this source), and ordered sections holding a course's lesson and quiz titles or a collection's grouped members. Lesson text is never copied.
fields.media: Always []: course videos, audio, and documents are never copied or referenced.
fields.artwork: The page's own share image: url (HTTPS image on academy.claude.com under /og/), alt (text or null), and sourceUrl (the resource page). Hotlinked from the official site, never re-hosted; null when the page has no image of its own.
fields.provenance: Source URLs (the page and any collections listing it), UTC fetch timestamp, normalized metadata SHA-256 hash, and collection method (crawler, manual, or fixture).

resource.idHint: Enter a ca_ resource ID, or select a resource from the Resources page to populate this request.

categories.title: List collections
categories.lede: Retrieve the collection slugs, display labels, and resource counts present in the current snapshot. Each Academy collection is one category.
categories.shapeNote: Pass any category id as the category query parameter on GET /v1/resources to list the resources in that collection.

response.items: List of collections present in the active snapshot.
response.id: Lowercase slug used as the category query parameter on /v1/resources.
response.label: Collection title from its public Academy page.
response.count: Number of indexed resources the collection lists in the current snapshot.
response.snapshotId: SHA-256 identifier of the snapshot serving these counts.

categories.empty: No collections are recorded in the current snapshot.

status.title: Snapshot freshness and coverage status
status.lede: Check whether the active snapshot is fresh, stale, or unavailable, along with refresh timestamps and per-collection coverage.

fields.freshness: Snapshot state: fresh, stale, or unavailable. Reports stale when the snapshot is older than 7 days, coverage is incomplete, the latest refresh failed, or the server fell back to a prior snapshot after a read error.
fields.resourceCount: Total number of validated resources in the active snapshot.
fields.coverage: Per-collection records reporting categoryId, state (complete, partial, or not-collected), discovered count (member links on the collection page), and collected count.

status.note: The response also reports snapshotId (active SHA-256 hash or null) and UTC timestamps for generatedAt, lastAttemptAt, and lastSuccessAt; failed refreshes keep serving the last validated snapshot.

notFound.lede: No documentation page matches this URL path.
